messages.subject: Questions in prediction
parts:
Hello,

I'm trying to make a one-infalted beta model with county effect for a survey data using the INLA.

The estimation of the parameters are great. However, when I use inla.posterior sample to produce 3000 posterior sample of the parameters to get the prediction, the predictions are narrow down to the population mean. 

Is there any way to solve this problem?

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Questions in prediction
parts:
its unclear what is the problem. inla.posterior.sample would produce sample
from the fitted model, from which you can generate new (predictive) data, if you
like. ..posterior.sample will not sample new data. I wonder if this is the
confusion?
